name: Gleam
typeSystem: Static, strong, Hindley-Milner-based type inference (similar in spirit to OCaml and Elm), with no null, no language-level exception-handling mechanism, and no implicit type coercion. Expected failures use Result, although panic and unsafe foreign code can still terminate execution.
runtime: Compiles to Erlang source for subsequent compilation to BEAM bytecode, or directly to JavaScript, so the same source can target either backend.

runtimes.name: BEAM VM
runtimes.role: Compiles to Erlang, then BEAM bytecode, gaining full OTP interoperability.

runtimes.name: JavaScript
runtimes.role: Compiles to JavaScript for browser and Node.js targets.

compilers.name: gleam build
compilers.role: The reference compiler, itself written in Rust, targeting either BEAM (via Erlang) or JavaScript.

concurrencyModel: On the BEAM target, inherits Erlang/OTP's lightweight actor processes and supervision trees; on the JavaScript target, concurrency follows the host's event loop.

codeExample.caption: Hello, World! plus a recursive factorial
